subject: Saturday maintenance window
body: Hi all, scheduled maintenance Saturday 02:00-04:00. VPN will be unavailable. No action needed. It is also on the intranet calendar.
explanation: A routine notice from a known sender that asks for nothing.

subject: Benefits enrolment closes on the 30th
body: Reminder: open enrolment closes on the 30th. Please log in to the HR portal using your own bookmark, not a link in this email. No reply is needed.
legit_cues: Tells you to use your own bookmark, not a link
Deadline is a published policy date
explanation: It has a deadline, but the deadline is a normal HR cycle and the message steers you to your own trusted route.

body: Hey {player_name}, can you drop the Q3 churn deck in the usual shared folder before our 2 pm sync?
legit_cues: Known colleague on the internal chat
explanation: A friendly, ordinary request from a verified colleague through the normal tool.

body: Fire drill tomorrow at 10:30. Meet at Assembly Point B. No reply needed.
explanation: A short-notice alert that requires no data or clicks.

subject: Expense report ER-2291 approved
body: Your expense report ER-2291 was approved and will be paid in Friday's run. Nothing further is needed.
legit_cues: Refers to a report you actually submitted
explanation: Confirmation of something you did yourself.

subject: Larkspur launch - all-hands Thursday
body: Congratulations to the analytics team on the Larkspur launch. Please join me at the all-hands on Thursday at 3 pm in the atrium.
explanation: An executive message that asks only for your attendance.

subject: Call transcript
body: Caller: 'Hi {player_name}, Tomasz from IT. I am not asking for anything. I am just letting you know ticket HD-3318 that you opened yesterday is resolved. If you want to check, call the helpdesk number in the handbook.'
legit_cues: Invites you to verify via the handbook number
explanation: The caller offers verification instead of discouraging it. That is the opposite of a scam pattern.

subject: Phishing awareness month starts Monday
body: Phishing awareness month starts Monday. Please complete the 15-minute module on the intranet learning page by the 20th.
legit_cues: Points to the intranet, not a link
explanation: A security topic is not a security threat. This is a planned programme with a reasonable deadline.

body: Hey! Loved the forecasting walkthrough you gave last week. Do you have time Thursday to show me the dashboard setup?
legit_cues: Asks for your time, not data
explanation: Warm and personal, but verified and asking for nothing sensitive.

subject: Thanks for completing the engagement survey
body: Thanks for completing the engagement survey. Everyone who finished is entered into the internal raffle for an extra day off. The winner will be announced at the all-hands.
legit_cues: No sign-in, fee or data request
explanation: A real prize notice asks for nothing from you.

body: Your password reset request has been processed. If you did not request it, please call the helpdesk number in the staff handbook.
legit_cues: Directs you to the handbook number, not a link
explanation: It confirms an action, includes no link, and tells you to use a known number if it is unexpected.
